$comment: A read/write tool surface for TaskDAG. Descriptions are written to be read once by a model and never looked up again: every branch says what it needs and what it costs. `reset` and `delete_graph` are deliberately NOT folded in — see docs/two-tool-surface.md.

what.description: board: counts + ready queue, and draws the card. ready: startable tasks only. task: one task whole, with its dependencies and what blocks it. graphs: every graph on this connector. mermaid: a diagram — narrow it, it is the one answer that costs real tokens.

graph.description: Graph handle from an earlier result. Omit for the most recent.

limit.description: what=ready: how many to name. The rest are counted.

keys.description: what=mermaid: draw only around these. Omit for the whole graph; keys that match nothing draw nothing.

status.description: what=mermaid: keep only these. Seeds survive regardless.

max_chars.description: what=mermaid: budget. Over it you get the size and a token, not half a diagram.

override_token.description: what=mermaid: from a previous overflow. Single use; the only way past the cap.

op.description: plan: add or change tasks and dependencies — MERGES, never deletes, so a new plan needs no wipe. update: one task's status or fields. unlink: remove dependency edges, keeping the tasks. Emptying or removing a whole graph is reset/delete_graph, not here.

graph.description: Graph handle. Omit for the most recent; op=plan mints one when there is none.

new_graph.description: op=plan: start a separate graph instead of merging. Ignored when graph is given.

title.description: op=plan: names the graph. Omit to leave it alone.

tasks.description: op=plan: tasks to create or update, matched by key.

key.description: Required, and must mean something: a slug from the title, e.g. "write-tests". "T3" and bare numbers are refused.

title.description: Short imperative title. Kept whole; shortened to 80 chars where it repeats.

detail.description: Free per call — it lives in the resource and read(what=task), never in a result. Be generous.

status.description: Omitted leaves an existing task's status alone.

priority.description: Higher sorts first in the ready queue. Default 0.

edges.description: op=plan adds these, op=unlink removes them. { from, to } reads "from depends on to": to must be done first. Cycles and self-edges are refused; duplicates are ignored.

status.description: op=update: start, finish, reopen or cancel. Reopening does not reopen dependents.

task_title.description: op=update: renames the task. `title` renames the graph, which is why this is separate.
